assessment: Recorded spare capacity does not establish usable capacity: acceptable windows, equipment needs and total demand are missing. Current observations do not establish the eight-week target's feasibility. Two hypotheses warrant bounded tests.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: allocating bookings from stated acceptable windows and equipment requirements, rather than inherited times, can meet more rehearsal needs within existing capacity.
openings.delta: Collect each group's weekly duration, acceptable windows and necessary equipment by phone or in person. Protect the two performances and each requesting group's weekly 60-minute entitlement, then allocate additional requested time; do not count an unwanted shorter session as a met need.
openings.prediction: If flexibility or room substitution is sufficient, a proposed allocation will accommodate previously declined needs without displacing protected access. If demand remains incompatible after collecting windows, this mechanism is insufficient.
openings.probe: Use the short contact conversations to construct one candidate week before changing reservations. Compare the share of stated needs fully met against the inherited schedule using the same demand data. Check equipment, entitlement and performance constraints; obtain agreement to changed times and track outcomes over eight weeks.
assumptions: Some groups accept alternative times or rooms.
Intake and allocation can fit within the total two-hour weekly administration average.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: recording each accepted booking or change once in a designated master calendar and confirming its room, date and time will reduce access conflicts and correction work.
openings.delta: Keep telephone and desk requests. Give each reservation a reference, amend its master entry before confirming, and mark the online copy with its update time. Use the master entry for key handoff.
openings.prediction: Calendar disagreements should disappear when the master is consulted; continuing conflicts despite matching confirmed entries would indicate causes beyond calendar synchronization.
openings.probe: For eight weeks, record each conflict's confirmed reservation details, master entry and mirror state. Measure total administration time, including updates and confirmations, and compare with the observed weeks; success requires fewer than two conflicts and an average at most 120 minutes.
assumptions: Existing desk staff can consult the master during current staffed hours.
Confirmation and correction savings offset the added recording effort.
